verifiedVia: Live Playwright + headless-Chromium rendered crawl of all 853 URLs (post-JavaScript DOM) on www.walgreens.com (2026-09-06)
method: walgreens.com is a React/SPA commerce site — content loads client-side via AJAX. Every URL was rendered in a real headless browser (networkidle + scroll + consent dismissal) so blocks that appear only after JS were captured (avg 73 data-testid components/page vs ~1-3 in raw HTML). Interactive journeys were verified with Playwright MCP where Akamai bot-protection allowed (PLP, store-locator); PDP/cart direct navigation is Akamai-403-gated, so those are documented from the rendered DOM captured during in-app navigation.
botProtectionNote: Direct navigation to PDP (/store/c/...-product) and /cart often returns Akamai 'Access Denied' (403); in-app navigation (click from PLP) works. 18 of 853 URLs returned non-200 for this reason and are flagged redirect-stub.

product-listing.observed: VERIFIED LIVE (/q/tylenol). PLP renders '105 items filtered*' count, a product grid (8 visible cards, lazy-loads more), and a filter rail. Sort dropdown has 8 options: Relevance, Top Sellers, Price Low→High, Price High→Low, Unit Price Low→High, Brand A-Z, Brand Z-A, Most Reviewed. Fulfillment filters (Pickup, Same-day delivery, Shipping), Brand facets, and Price min/max + Apply. Product cards show title, brand, price, rating/review, promotion/tag, offer badges, FSA label. Pagination via second-page-navigation. Cards link to PDPs.

product-filters.observed: VERIFIED LIVE on PLP. Facet rail: fulfillment (pickup-filter, sdd-filter, shipping-filter), brand (brand-filter, brand-walgreens-checkbox), price (set-minimum-price / set-maximum-price / apply-price), and beauty-specific facets (filter-foundation-color, filter-undertone) on beauty PLPs. applied-filters chips + clear. Client-side, synced to the grid + item count.

product-detail.observed: Captured from rendered DOM. PDP exposes pdp-product-title, product gallery (productImage-gettab tabs), product specifications table (brand, product-type, FSA/HSA-eligible, size/count, UPC, item-code), description with show-more toggle (toggle-accordion), variant selection (multi-variant-title, select-lipstick-color + foundation-color/undertone for beauty; right-eye-power/left-eye-power for contact lenses), reviews (product-review), save-to-shopping-list, and Walgreens-brand tagging. Direct nav is Akamai-403-gated; re-verify add-to-cart/variant interaction via in-app click in a commerce env.

fulfillment-cart.observed: Captured from rendered PDP DOM. Fulfillment selector: pickup-radio-btn / sdd-radio-btn / shipping-radio-btn, each with stock text (pickup-stock-text), ready message (pickup-ready-msg-text), and store address (pickup-address-text); quantity dropdown (qty-dropdown-pickup); add-for-pickup-btn / add-to-cart-btn; check-other-stores for availability elsewhere. Add-to-cart updates the header cart count.

store-locator.observed: VERIFIED LIVE (/storelocator/24-hour-pharmacy/...). 'Stores near <zip>' with store cards (address, city/zip, distance, phone, per-service hours + open/closed for Store & Photo / Pharmacy / Lab Services, 'Pickup available'). Interactive Google Map with numbered markers synced to the list. Filter chips ('24-hr pharmacy Remove') + Filters overlay + clear-all. 'Load more' is CLIENT-SIDE: verified 'Showing 1-10 of 99' → '1-20 of 99', appending 10 cards + 10 markers, no reload. 'Browse stores by state' SEO directory. Handles 'store temporarily closed' alerts. Cards link to /locator/...id= store-detail.

store-detail.observed: Captured from rendered DOM (/locator/...id=). Individual store page: address, phone, per-service hours + open/closed status (store, pharmacy, photo, lab), save-preferred-store (star). Service entry points: schedule vaccine (COVID / flu / pneumonia), photo (cards, prints, same-day pickup, projects) with 'see all' overlays, FedEx returns, propane / Blue Rhino exchange, beauty consultation, in-store product search box.

recommendations-carousel.observed: Captured from rendered category/home DOM. Merchandising rails: sales-offers, coupons, top-sellers, highest-rated, newest-arrivals, recently-viewed (RVI), more-to-explore, plus all-categories & top-brands sections. Horizontal carousels of product/offer cards; cards link to PDP/PLP or clip a coupon.

header.observed: VERIFIED LIVE (present on every rendered page). Global commerce header: logo, keyword/item search box + Search, 'Nearest store <address>' selector (opens change-store overlay), Account Menu, and cart icon with live 'N items' count. Mega-menu: Pharmacy, Health Services, Shop, Savings, Photo, Financial Services + Weekly Ad / seasonal / Vaccinations. Rotating promo bar above header.

cart.observed: Cart icon (live count) in header links to /cart/view-ui; recommendation XFs (buy-again, featured-categories, RVI) render in cart context. Full cart/checkout is session + Akamai gated (direct nav 403); documented from header + XF evidence — walk add→cart→checkout in a commerce/logged-in env.

account-auth.observed: Account Menu in header; sign-in / register / password routes and guest order-lookup (order-number-input, last-name-input, phone-number-input, lookup-search-btn). Family & care-management account areas. Auth-gated; documented from testid + route evidence.
